title: Cash Variance by Cashier
description: How each cashier’s closed drawer sessions came out against the expected cash: how many, the total and average variance, and whether the errors lean towards shortage or overage.
rangeInvalid: The start date must not be after the end date.
emptyTitle: No closed sessions in this range
emptyDescription: No closed drawer sessions with a count fall in this period for the branches you can see.
loadFailed: Failed to load the cash variance report.
footnote: Negative = shortage. Variances of different currencies are never added together. “Short share” is the portion of sessions with a variance that were short; a high share points to a pattern, not a one-off miss. The cashier is the user who opened the drawer session.
